query: Add a credits system to our SaaS: users buy credits, each API call uses one, and I need a history page.
Our game stores coins in users.coins and support keeps asking why someone's balance is what it is. Can we get a proper transaction log?
Two purchases at the same time took a user's balance below zero. Fix the wallet so that can't happen.
We only have a balance column on the users table. Migrate it to a ledger without changing what users see.
I need a points table for our loyalty program where every change is recorded and a nightly job checks that the totals add up.
Add a wallet with a transaction history to our Laravel app, and make sure two requests cannot spend the same balance.
In our Next.js app with Prisma two parallel purchases both succeed when the user can only afford one. Fix the points balance.
Verify the signature on our payment provider's webhook before we credit the order.
Customers who get a refund keep their credits. Make refunds take the credits back.
Set up double-entry accounting with a chart of accounts for our company's books.
Write a Prisma migration that renames the username column to handle.
